versions.changelog:
autoagent 0.8.9

- Enhanced setup flow: Every invocation starts a fresh session and lets users choose a custom sandbox path, with improved path resolution rules.
- Interactive, user-driven scoring: Setup phase now focuses on collaborative definition and approval of `scoring.md`.
- New prompt to ask about external scripts/tools used by the guidance, and a phase to analyze and suggest improvements for them.
- Improved plateau detection: Considers “within 5 points” for the last 10 scores (or all available if fewer).
- Subagent invocation now uses explicit session spawn parameters with clear instructions to include test cases in prompt and set timeouts.
- Updated documentation and test case handling to reflect these changes.

No changes detected in this version.

- Version 0.8.7 released with no modifications to SKILL.md or other files.
- All features and documentation remain the same as the previous release.

autoagent v0.8.7 brings automated prompt and agent guidance optimization with iterative scoring.

- New "autoagent" skill enables continuous improvement of agent guidance via a Karpathy-style feedback loop.
- Interactive setup wizard collects guidance location, task description, test inputs, scoring criteria, and schedule.
- Initializes a sandbox directory with cloned guidance, fixtures, and scoring files for safe, non-destructive experimentation.
- On a 5-minute cron schedule, automatically proposes, tests, and scores improvements; keeps changes only when scores rise.
- Detects plateaus (no progress for 10 runs), pauses optimization, and notifies user for review.
- Complete change log and result history logged for transparency and user auditing.
